initialFailure.cause: Test harness only: React dev StrictMode initiated a second request; first-only delay immediately returned success for that request. Also the loading veil parent has height:0; the visible spinner child is the proper target.
initialFailure.fix: Delay all initial requests until explicit release, mark successful retry separately, and assert spinner child visibility. Rerun 10/10 passed.

manualVisualReview: PC/mobile empty-state screenshots inspected: consistent centered panels, legible text, no clipped empty messages. Populated tables retain horizontal scrolling.
limitations: Browser API responses are synthetic fixtures; no authenticated production API tested.
Mobile viewport WebKit is not a physical iPhone.
Full backend/database financial E2E not rerun for this display-only change.
